_comment: Where the game server is. THIS FILE IS THE CANONICAL COPY: the publish-server-json
workflow republishes it onto the latest GitHub release whenever it changes on main,
and every launcher fetches it from there. Moving the server is a one-line edit of
host below - no client update, nothing to install, players just press Play.
host is a Tailscale address, so it only resolves for people on the tailnet. That is
the point: it is not a public server, and the launcher checks Tailscale is connected
before blaming the server for being down.
name: Night City Online
_coordComment: The assistant coordination API lives on Cam's machine regardless of where the game
server runs - coordHost keeps the dev-key tool working when host points elsewhere.
Anyone with the dev role can fetch their key from it through the launcher's settings;
it is not published anywhere public, because a key that ships with the installer is
_tailscaleComment: Invite to Cam's tailnet, so joining is a button rather than a link he has to send
by hand every time. The launcher only shows it to people it has already verified
are in the Discord - see the note in index.html.
